id: Pirates of the Caribbean: At World's End (2007)

facts.text: Nine Pirate Lords, one long table. We eat, we vote, and nobody touches the apples but me.
facts.why: Not a line Barbossa says. The apple belongs to the first film, and at the Court Barbossa argues to free Calypso while Teague keeps the Code. No quote page could be opened.
facts.fix: Nine Pirate Lords, one long table. We eat, we vote, and nobody leaves until it is settled.

fix_note.text: Nine Pirate Lords, one long table. We eat, we vote, and nobody leaves until it is settled.

vibe.verdict: The map fold and the Singapore dishes suit the film well, but the words rarely use the big moments.
